fields.name: work_memory_low
fields.meaning: Live game working memory (battery-backed, not save data; holds the live party block at 0x06A0-0x0CF7)
fields.evidence: diff: changes on every step in all saves; code: loader copies record data back over 0x06A0 (d000:911a)

fields.name: copy0_marker_B
fields.meaning: Start marker of save copy 0, always 0x42 (ASCII B)
fields.evidence: code: written last as commit flag (d000:90d7), checked (d000:917f); trace: written after all data

fields.name: obj_x_px
fields.meaning: Map object X position in pixels, 16 objects; object 0 is the player party and equals tile X*16+8 [copied from memory 0x3980]
fields.evidence: diff: tracks tile X across natural saves (1/6/5/2 -> 0x18/0x68/0x58/0x28)

fields.name: obj_y_px
fields.meaning: Map object Y position in pixels, 16 objects; equals tile Y*16+8 [copied from memory 0x39A0]
fields.evidence: diff: tracks tile Y across natural saves

fields.name: obj_x_px_copy
fields.meaning: Second X position per object, same value as X when standing; the camera follows it [copied from memory 0x39C0]
fields.evidence: code: camera code reads state+0x40+obj*2 (d000:a82b); diff: equals obj_x_px in saves

fields.name: obj_y_px_copy
fields.meaning: Second Y position per object [copied from memory 0x39E0]
fields.evidence: code: camera code reads state+0x60+obj*2 (d000:a82b)

fields.name: unknown_obj_a
fields.meaning: Unknown per-object data [copied from memory 0x3A00]
fields.evidence: no decoding evidence

fields.name: obj_tile_x
fields.meaning: Map object X position in tiles, 16 objects [copied from memory 0x3A40]
fields.evidence: diff: object 0 = 1/6/5/2 across saves while walking around town

fields.name: obj_tile_y
fields.meaning: Map object Y position in tiles, 16 objects [copied from memory 0x3A60]
fields.evidence: diff: object 0 = 4/3/2/2 across saves

fields.name: unknown_obj_b
fields.meaning: Unknown per-object data (0xFFFF entries present) [copied from memory 0x3A80]

fields.name: obj_facing

fields.name: unknown_105
fields.meaning: Unknown [copied from memory 0x3C05]
fields.evidence: no decoding evidence

fields.name: script_result
fields.meaning: Result of the last story-script command (menu choice, yes/no, check outcome) [copied from memory 0x3CD0]
fields.evidence: code: interpreter and opcodes write state+0x350 (d000:8940, buy/sell result 0/1/2)

fields.name: unknown_351
fields.meaning: Unknown story-script words (one byte differs between saves) [copied from memory 0x3CD1]
fields.evidence: code refs to state+0x352/+0x354 (d000:9708); meaning unknown

fields.name: facing_mask
fields.meaning: Player facing as a bit flag (1, 2, 4, 8) [copied from memory 0x3CD6]
fields.evidence: diff: 1/2/4/2 across saves, follows the d-pad

fields.name: script_pc
fields.meaning: Story-script position to resume at after loading (ROM address) [copied from memory 0x3CD8]
fields.evidence: code: the save command stores its address operand here (d000:9076); in ROM the save event reads 2A 00/01 <0x237FE4>; the loader restores it so the interpreter continues there

fields.name: script_stash
fields.meaning: Stashed story-script position used when an event script takes over and returns [copied from memory 0x3CDC]
fields.evidence: code: written only by d000:9734/973e (current pc saved), restored by d000:9777/9781/97a7/97b1; diff: equals the live call-stack top in every save

fields.name: script_stack
fields.meaning: Story-script call stack, 8 return addresses [copied from memory 0x3CE0]
fields.evidence: code: pushed by d000:7e94, popped by d000:7ede

fields.name: stack_index
fields.meaning: Live top index of the call stack (push counts down, pop counts up, mod 8) [copied from memory 0x3D00]
fields.evidence: code: d000:7e94/d000:7ede; 7 in every save = one live call

fields.name: unknown_382
fields.meaning: Unknown story-script word [copied from memory 0x3D02]
fields.evidence: code writers d000:8de0/9f96, readers d000:a925/a999; meaning unknown

fields.name: encounter_flags
fields.meaning: Flags gating random encounters [copied from memory 0x3D04]
fields.evidence: code: written by d000:96cb, tested by the encounter opcode (d000:971e/9769) before stashing the script position

fields.name: current_map
fields.meaning: Current map number; loading rebuilds this map [copied from memory 0x3D06]
fields.evidence: code: loader passes it to the map builder (d000:9129/839e); 0x0B (same town) in every save

fields.name: battle_counters
fields.meaning: Counters advanced by the battle code [copied from memory 0x3D08]
fields.evidence: code: incremented at d000:c868 and nearby

fields.name: battle_index
fields.meaning: Index used by the battle code [copied from memory 0x3D0C]
fields.evidence: code: d000:d766; diff: 0 in early saves, 0xE6 in later ones

fields.name: unknown_38e

fields.evidence: no decoding evidence

fields.name: shop_flag_a

fields.name: unknown_41c
fields.meaning: Unknown [copied from memory 0x3D9C]
fields.evidence: no decoding evidence

fields.name: copy0_marker_E
fields.meaning: Middle marker, always 0x45 (ASCII E)
fields.evidence: code: d000:90d2 writes, d000:9178 checks

fields.name: team_count
fields.meaning: Number of entries in the team list [copied from memory 0x06A0]
fields.evidence: code: cleared (d000:a172), incremented (d000:a1b4); 0 in every save

fields.name: team_list
fields.meaning: Team member character numbers, 11 places, 0xFF = empty [copied from memory 0x06A1]
fields.evidence: code: d000:a17d/a1a6; all empty, matching the "own no units" screen

fields.name: unknown_6ac
fields.meaning: Unknown (zero in every save) [copied from memory 0x06AC]
fields.evidence: no decoding evidence

fields.name: money
fields.meaning: Money, at most 9999; buying subtracts the price, selling adds half the price [copied from memory 0x06B7]
fields.evidence: code: set (d000:a034), buy (d000:a066/a09a), sell with 9999 cap (d000:a0c9); screen shows 00G

fields.name: unknown_6b9
fields.meaning: Unknown (zero in every save) [copied from memory 0x06B9]
fields.evidence: no decoding evidence

fields.name: enemy_level_a
fields.meaning: Story value A for random-battle strength [copied from memory 0x06C0]
fields.evidence: code: set by story events (d000:9e25); enemy power = (A+B)*2 + 1d6 (f000:3f53)

fields.name: enemy_level_b
fields.meaning: Story value B added to the one above [copied from memory 0x06C2]
fields.evidence: code: set by story events (d000:9e1a); read with A (f000:3f56)

fields.name: unknown_6c4
fields.meaning: Unknown [copied from memory 0x06C4]
fields.evidence: no decoding evidence

fields.name: item_count
fields.meaning: Number of entries in the consumables list (buying refuses at 39) [copied from memory 0x099E]
fields.evidence: code: buy checks 0x27 (d000:a079); add/remove keep the list dense (f000:b234/b2af); 1 in every save

fields.name: item_list
fields.meaning: Consumables list, 2 bytes per entry: item number, quantity (cap 99); item 1 is the Repair Device (heals 20 HP) [copied from memory 0x099F]
fields.evidence: code: find/add/remove (f000:b030/b234/b2af); saves hold item 1 x8, matching the 8 shown on the item screen

fields.name: parts_count
fields.meaning: Number of entries in the parts list (40 places) [copied from memory 0x0B2F]
fields.evidence: code: incremented/decremented on add/remove (f000:b654/b6b8); 0 in every save

fields.name: parts_list
fields.meaning: Parts list, 40 entries of 9 bytes: part number, kind, 3 table bytes, kind value word, kind parameter word (same layout as equipped parts) [copied from memory 0x0B30]
fields.evidence: code: built by f000:b19d, added by f000:b5f6/b654, removed by f000:b6b8; empty in every save

fields.name: catalogue_owned
fields.meaning: Collection record: one bit per mapped unit/part number (384), set when obtained [copied from memory 0x0C98]
fields.evidence: code: set by f000:bcd6; bit number mapped through ROM tables (f000:bc6f); a clear path exists but no caller decoded

fields.name: catalogue_ever
fields.meaning: Collection record: one bit per mapped number, set once and never cleared [copied from memory 0x0CC8]
fields.evidence: code: set together with owned (f000:bcd6)

fields.name: copy0_marker_C
fields.meaning: End marker, always 0x43 (ASCII C)
fields.evidence: code: d000:90cd writes, d000:9171 checks

fields.name: copy0_checksum
fields.meaning: 16-bit sum of all data bytes of copy 0 (markers not included)
fields.evidence: code: written (d000:90c9), checked (d000:916b); recomputed over every valid save image; trace shows the accumulation

fields.name: copy1
fields.meaning: Second save copy, same layout as copy 0 (0x1779-0x21F9); every save writes it with identical content
fields.evidence: diff: copy 0 == copy 1 in every saved state; code: slot base = 0x0CF8+n*0xA81; ROM holds both slot commands

fields.name: work_memory_high
fields.meaning: Live game working memory (not save data; holds the live script state at 0x3980-0x3DA3)
fields.evidence: diff: changes on every step

fields.name: not_used
fields.meaning: The game never writes the console's internal EEPROM during play
fields.evidence: diff: identical in every observed state (22 nonzero bytes are constant system data, not save data)
